title: What Are the Nigerian Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: article to refresh. Publish method: update in place, change slug and path to /expert-advice/nigerian-wedding-traditions, confirm the old URL returns a 301. Check for duplicate Nigerian pages. Protect its rankings. Drop the 'know how to party' framing.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch (one render-wait retry if the body is empty; if the call is DECLINED, do not retry and infer coverage from rankings). SEO pulls its ranked keywords (US and AU), checks duplicates, and the outline keeps covering every query with real volume. Never reuse wording; drop errors.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('In many Yoruba families...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records').

DIVERSITY: Nigeria has more than 250 ethnic groups; Yoruba, Igbo and Hausa-Fulani customs differ. Say so once, tie each custom to its group only where a source does; faith (Christian, Muslim) only where sourced. Terms with tone marks as sources give them. No stereotypes; nothing on harmful or contested practices.

Likely customs (brief finalises): Yoruba introduction and engagement (idana), bride price and gift list (no amounts), aso ebi, gele and fila, spraying money (no amounts), prostrating or kneeling greetings; Igbo iku aka (knocking on the door), bride price, igba nkwu (wine carrying); Hausa-Fulani nikah (fatiha) and kamu; the white wedding alongside the traditional one.
UNESCO only where its own text links an element to weddings. Confirm each page live and its title.

Destination angle: Smartraveller Nigeria checked live (overall level and states at 'Do not travel'). If overall is 'Reconsider your need to travel' or higher, do not suggest marrying in Nigeria; angle becomes Nigerian-Australian and mixed-heritage couples bringing these customs to weddings at home in Australia or at destinations elsewhere (aso ebi fabric, timing of traditional and white weddings, music, space for spraying and dancing). Any legal line only from Smartraveller or the Australian High Commission Abuja, as questions; 'as at November 2026'.

Sources: Nigerian government and culture pages (e.g. National Council for Arts and Culture), British Museum, Smithsonian NMAfA, V&A (aso oke), UNESCO, Britannica, academic sources. Never competitor wedding sites, vendor blogs or Wikipedia.

Links: /destinations/africa, /expert-advice/african-honeymoons-private-safari-and-island-escapes-by-season, /wonderland-studio/wedding-website-templates/african (priority Studio template), related traditions drafts, /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=nigerian-wedding-traditions&utm_content=primary|secondary.

Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes (folded aso oke fabric, kola nuts) labelled illustrative pending approval; old-page images only if licence confirmed.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches (A: Yoruba and Hausa-Fulani customs; B: Igbo customs, shared customs (aso ebi, spraying, white wedding), UNESCO, Smartraveller and diaspora), 15 min HARD by the clock, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; self_qa.confidence must be a number; must_include_coverage entries must be objects with covered_by as an array; no extra sourcing rounds; never retry a declined call. Stop at the limit: start no new reads after 15 minutes.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md (single point of contact; fee and inclusions in writing); no implied help with legal or church paperwork.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; no vendor or venue names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
